attempted_claim: Let (G,𝒫) be a finitely generated, non-elementary relatively hyperbolic pair with Bowditch boundary M=∂(G,𝒫) connected, planar (homeomorphic to a subspace of S²), and without global cut points. For a Dehn filling φ:(G,𝒫)→(Ḡ,P̄), write P̄∞ for the infinite image peripheral subgroups. Must ∂(Ḡ,P̄∞) be planar for every sufficiently long M-finite filling, where M-finite means that the filling kernel in each finitely generated, more-than-one-ended peripheral subgroup has finite index?
decisive_failure: The investigation was bounded by a literature-and-deduction pass without capacity to develop the missing relative spiderweb approximation with uniform linear connectedness, the Claytor/Ivanov finite-graph pullback for proper planar Peano limits under finite peripheral quotients, or peripheral control for multi-ended relatively one-ended groups; a future attack would need those new theorems or a fully computed counterexample boundary.
